questions.prompt: Apply an eight-bit left shift by two to 00010110₂ and bitwise AND to 00110110₂ with 00001111₂. Give both results in binary.
questions.feedback: Model answer: Left shift 00010110 << 2 = 01011000 (eight-bit, zero-filled). AND 00110110 ∧ 00001111 = 00000110.

blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: time complexity — Asymptotic growth in algorithm work.
auxiliary space — Extra memory used by an algorithm.
Big O — Upper asymptotic bound commonly used to classify growth.

blocks.title: Analyse the loops
blocks.text: One full loop runs n iterations; a pair of n-sized nested loops performs n² inner iterations.

blocks.title: Separate time and space
blocks.text: Big O time counts growth of work; auxiliary space measures extra storage beyond the original input.

blocks.title: Compare feasible scales
blocks.text: At n=16, exponential growth can be dramatically more expensive than linear growth. Big O omits constants and measured run time.

blocks.title: Worked example · Predict first
blocks.text: One scan has eight iterations, giving linear growth O(n).

blocks.title: Worked example · Explain the answer
blocks.text: Nested loops perform 8×8=64 inner iterations, giving quadratic growth O(n²).
